implementation_required.reason: No existing deterministic operation or reusable frozen screen covers REGIME_CONTEXT_CONDITIONED; authorized_deterministic_operations_current_epoch is empty and the only prior artifact (Epoch23) is explicitly non-durable exploratory code, not a frozen executor. Genuinely new repository machinery is required, not a deterministic-in-principle rerun of existing tooling.

proposed_frozen_design_sketch.closure: descriptive elimination of this specific frozen law only; no ranking, no economic promotion, no family closure claimed regardless of outcome
proposed_frozen_design_sketch.event: regime-conditioned directional continuation event, chronological earliest-first selection, non-overlapping spacing
proposed_frozen_design_sketch.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across all eligible representatives
proposed_frozen_design_sketch.regime_classifier: ATR-percentile-rank based HIGH_VOL_EXPANDING vs LOW_VOL_COMPRESSED context, computed identically to Epoch23 params but frozen before any new observation
proposed_frozen_design_sketch.test: per-symbol one-sided exact binomial continuation-vs-0.5 test evaluated independently within each chronological half, symbol counted supported only if both halves pass at a frozen threshold

decision.why_fresh_not_reuse: Epoch23 REGIME_CONTEXT_CONDITIONED evidence is explicitly design_status=EXPLORATORY_NON_ECONOMIC_DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY_NO_DURABLE_PRE_OUTCOME_FREEZE with interpretation_boundary stating no durable prospective freeze binds its thresholds and it cannot serve as independent confirmation. A new frontier freeze must therefore predeclare its own split/statistic/threshold/multiplicity rule independent of the Epoch23 observed regime fractions, mirroring the Epoch24-27 freeze->screen->result pattern, not reparameterizing Epoch23's diagnostic.

objective.goal: Author a prospectively frozen, non-economic REGIME_CONTEXT_CONDITIONED structural stability spec and its deterministic screen implementation, then execute it across all currently eligible broker-native structural representatives with already-accepted 13-week M5 history, to determine whether this mechanism family exhibits any chronologically stable, breadth-material structural edge before any economic consideration.
objective.information_gain_rationale: TREND_MOMENTUM, MEAN_REVERSION and BREAKOUT_VOLATILITY_EXPANSION frozen structural screens (Epoch24/25/27) each returned zero supported/stable symbols across the full 41-representative frontier. CROSS_SECTIONAL_RANKING and CAUSAL_ML_PREDICTIVE_OR_STATE_MODEL already produced valid, exact-identity-consumed survivors (V2-C023, V2-C025). CARRY_TERM_STRUCTURE remains blocked by an unresolved, fail-closed metadata authority gap (no new data justified yet). REGIME_CONTEXT_CONDITIONED is the only open mechanism family with (a) zero incremental data cost — full 13w M5 development data is already accepted for all 41 representatives — and (b) only non-durable, explicitly-declared exploratory descriptive evidence (Epoch23) that carries no prospective freeze and therefore cannot itself be reused as a structural result. Converting this exploratory evidence into a genuinely fresh, predeclared frozen law (distinct split-half design, thresholds, and multiplicity correction not derived from the Epoch23 observed outcome) is the highest-information legal next step: it closes the last cost-free open family gap without reusing any opened identity or outcome-exposed diagnostic.
